predecessors.name: Jin (Korean state)
predecessors.text: Byeonhan, which 'appears to be descended from the Jin state of southern Korea'

successors.name: Gaya confederacy
successors.text: the Nakdong basin around Gimhae, where 'most Byeonhan states joined' the Gaya confederacy

ledger.x: 91 BCE: the Byeonhan confederacy of twelve statelets appears on the south coast.
300: Byeonhan gives way to the Gaya confederacy.

wars.name: Eight Port Kingdoms War
wars.outcome: No territorial result on the pages; the Gaya page dates the war 'c.

certainty.note: A confederacy of twelve statelets with no frontier on any page; the Cliopatria outline is a block of the south coast.
